company_memory.content: Uplora is the parent Commerce-Tech engine. Akyzer is the proprietary D2C e-commerce brand. StoreIK is the core merchant platform product.
Standard responsive website: ₹6,000–₹10,000. E-commerce / catalog storefront: ₹12,000–₹25,000. Minimum 50% upfront payment required before design starts.
Never accept multi-vendor marketplace scopes under ₹50,000; it creates timeline blowouts and strains Partner capacity.
Any new business or dropshipping concept must remain in 7-day quarantine with customer validation before any development commences.
